info.name: JFrog Artifactory REST API
info.description:
REST API for managing artifacts, repositories, security, and system configuration in JFrog Artifactory. Artifactory is a universal binary repository manager that integrates with all major CI/CD and DevOps tools to provide an end-to-end automated solution for tracking artifacts from development to production.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog
